description_en: Renews multiple subscription Cloud Phone instances in a batch
description_zh: 云手机预付费实例批量续费接口
kebab_example: aliyun cloudphone renew-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id cp-xxxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: RenewInstances

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs to renew. The list can contain a maximum of 20 elements
parameters.help_zh: 续费实例列表。列表最大 20 个元素
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the renewal period. Valid values:
Year: subscription. Valid values for the period: 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5.
Month: subscription. Valid values for the period: 1, 2, 3, and 6.
Hour: pay-as-you-go. Valid value for the period: 1.

Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
续费周期单位，支持
Year 包年包月，支持年：1, 2, 3, 4, 5
Month 包年包月，支持月：1, 2, 3, 6
Hour 按量，支持小时：1

默认Month
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of ClientToken can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性
parameters.name: client_token
